title: Why Finite Intelligence Works in an Infinite World: A Mathematical Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.18538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An information system often has to learn before it knows what it will be asked. A finite representation can succeed without recording an infinite environment in full when those asks share collective structure, rather than demand unrelated facts scattered arbitrarily across it. We formalize this phenomenon through future-task information, the minimum retained information needed to preserve decision value relative to the available evidence. A joint decision-regret state records posterior comparisons among actions for every permitted task. Under compactness assumptions, every retained representation admits a calibrated replacement based on this state, preserving all task regrets without increasing information; the resulting information-regret curve equals an operational coding rate. Two exact boundaries govern finite preservation: weak-star closure for a fixed action count, and the singular mass of the source-evidence law when all finite

translated_title: 为什么有限智能能在无限世界中有效：一种数学理论
translated_abstract: 一个信息系统往往需要在知道自己将被问及什么之前就进行学习。当这些请求共享集体结构，而不是要求掌握散布在环境中任意位置的不相关事实时，有限的表示可以在不完整记录无限环境的情况下取得成功。我们通过“未来任务信息”来形式化这一现象，即相对于可用证据而言，保持决策价值所需的最小保留信息。一个联合决策-后悔状态记录了每个允许任务中各行动之间的后验比较。在紧性假设下，每个保留的表示都可以基于该状态进行校准替换，在不增加信息的情况下保留所有任务后悔；由此产生的信息-后悔曲线等于一个操作性编码率。两个精确的边界支配着有限保存：对于固定的行动数量是弱星闭包，以及当所有有限……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“未来任务信息”理论，证明当任务请求共享集体结构时，有限的信息表示足以在无限环境中保持决策价值，并给出了有限保存的两个精确数学边界条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the theory of "future-task information," proving that finite representations suffice to preserve decision value in infinite environments when task requests share collective structure, and establishes two exact mathematical boundaries for finite preservation.
